statement: In every characteristic p>0 and every local dimension N>=3, algebraizable normal strict-local examples with regular punctures and regular principal punctured divisor have an injected (Z/p)^min(3,N-1) in the ordinary integral Picard restriction kernel.
depends_on: C.3bf actual-family construction; elementary ordinary plane-quartic and normal-boundary calculations; Milne Lemma9.5; Brion coherent Theorem1.1 and isogenyII Eq3.8; Hacon-Patakfalvi v2 Proposition2.3.2; Illusie2.6/2.7.2; formal existence/Popescu/Elkik
notes: Fully specified generic coefficients, plus a terminating finite-field specialization. Hence examples over Fpbar and every algebraically closed characteristic-p field. At N3 only a rank-two subgroup is asserted, not exact full-kernel rank. Integral only. Root and two peers full proof PASS; auxiliary p2/p3 actual cup certificates are separately documented.
